description: Wait until a CSS selector appears or text is present on the page (e.g. after a navigation or async render). Returns { ok, waitedMs } — ok=false on timeout. To wait for the network to go quiet instead, use browser_wait_for_idle.

text.description: Substring of page text to wait for (if no selector).

timeoutMs.description: Max time to wait before giving up, in ms (default 10000).

name: browser_wait_for
